messages.text:
The first comparison found two real classes of mismatch: Windows newline translation and a few command/parser edge cases.

I’m fixing stdout/stderr emission to write exact `\n` bytes, keeping raw converter/string-join commands distinct from ordinary string values, and tightening record/argument parsing.

commands.receipt:
OK  3 + 4
OK  1 + 2 * 3
OK  (1 + 2) * 3
OK  5 mod 2
OK  5.25 mod 2
OK  3 ** 3
OK  10 / 4
OK  10 // 4
OK  1 == 1
OK  true and false
OK  not false
OK  "abc" =~ "b"
OK  "a" in "abc"
OK  [1, 2, 3] | get 1
OK  [1, 2, 3] | length
OK  [1, 2, 3] | first
OK  [3, 1, 2] | sort | to json -r
OK  [a, B, d, C, f] | sort -i | to json --raw
OK  1..5 | math sum
OK  1..5 | where $it > 3 | to json -r
OK  [[a b]; [jim susie] [3 4]] | to json -r
OK  [[a b]; [jim susie] [3 4]] | get a.0
OK  [[a b]; [jim susie] [3 4]].b.1
OK  [[name, age]; [paul, 21]] | columns | get 0
OK  [[name, age]; [paul, 21]] | reject age | to json -r
OK  "hello world" | split row " " | get 1
OK  "hello world" | split column " " | get column1.0
BAD "a-b-c" | str replace "-" "+"
  ref  0 'a+b-c\n' ''
  port 1 '' 'Error: nu::shell::error\n\n  x list index out of range\n\n'
OK  "abc" | str length
OK  "AbC" | str downcase
OK  [a b c] | str join "-"
OK  char nl | str length
BAD {foo: 3, bar: "x"} | to json -r
  ref  0 '{"foo":3,"bar":"x"}\n' ''
  port 1 '' 'Error: nu::parser::parse_mismatch\n\n  x expected :\n\n'
OK  [[a b]; [1 2]] | to csv
OK  [1,2,3] | to nuon
OK  null | to nuon
OK  pwd
BAD ls | length
  ref  0 '10\n' ''
  port 0 '11\n' ''
BAD path exists REFERENCE_BINARY.txt
  ref  1 '' 'Error: nu::parser::extra_positional\n\n  x Extra positional argument.\n   ,-[source:1:13]\n 1 | path exists REFERENCE_BINARY.txt\n   :             ^^^^^^^^^^|^^^^^^^^^\n   :                       `-- extra positional argument\n   `----\n  help: Usa'
  port 1 '' 'Error: nu::parser::extra_positional\n\n  x Extra positional argument.\n\n'
